rationale: Fixed direct check for unit-claim-install-snapshot-alignment (obligation claim-install-snapshot-alignment). The harness seeds a log through index 5, declares (as a prerequisite) that the receiver holds entries above the installed snapshot index, installs a snapshot at index 3 through the production handler, and asserts that the receiver's effective last entry stays within the installed snapshot index after an accepted install. Identity is the declared op_id; the oracle reads emitted event fields, not tests_passed. Local construction testing in a copy of the captured module already shows the state the obligation is about - compaction from 1 to 3, two entries surviving, lastApplied and snapshot index 3, effective last entry (5, term 1), within_installed_snapshot false - but that run is construction knowledge only; this product fixes the bytes, premises and oracle for fresh controller execution. Two adaptations are declared in the plan: with skipStartup there is no runFSM, so an explicit substitute goroutine answers restore futures with success (the proposition concerns the handler's bookkeeping, for which a successful restore is a premise), and TrailingLogs is set to 0 so compaction is not skipped by the trailing-log guard. Neither adaptation touches log or snapshot alignment logic, and no target code is modified.
